template_rules: Replace every placeholder with a verified value.
Do not send legal redress text without a current eligibility check.
Do not combine money with different currencies into one total.
Use call scripts as guidance. Adapt the answer to the caller's question.
redress_text_lines: Condor participates in consumer dispute resolution through Schlichtungsstelle Reise & Verkehr e. V.
The address is Fasanenstraße 81, 10623 Berlin, Germany.
You can ask this body to review an eligible unresolved dispute.
You can also use the applicable court process.

A refund of the covered ticket parts.
Alternative carriage at the earliest opportunity under comparable conditions.
Alternative carriage on a later date that suits you, subject to available seats.
Please tell us which option you choose.
